description: This file defines the IBasketViewModelService interface, which declares methods for retrieving and mapping basket data within the web application.

classes.name: IBasketViewModelService
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for working with basket view models, including retrieval and mapping operations.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an existing basket for the specified user, or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts the total number of items in the user's basket.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket entity object to a BasketViewModel.
